source.author: Shaan Johari
source.coverage: 46 expanded cards, usage and bonus notes
source.notes: Original implementation notes, not a verbatim archive; original full cards remain at source.

styles.name: Glow World
styles.motion: Flat rounded illustrated layers; parallax push, split hero, ignite interior.
styles.never: No channel mascots, glossy realism or copied scenes.

styles.name: Flat Cartoon
styles.look: Side-view flat-shaded characters act a cause and reaction
styles.motion: Side-view flat-shaded characters act a cause and reaction; land one caption.
styles.never: No real faces, gradients or heavy outlines.

styles.name: Hologram
styles.motion: Frosted blue model; orbit, scan one red focus, draw its route and leaders.
styles.never: No HUD clutter, realistic branding or overlapping labels.

styles.name: Red Relief
styles.motion: Raised charcoal terrain; flood a red region, stamp an emblem, trace a route.
styles.never: No satellite substitute, portraits or second highlight color.

styles.name: Ink Doodle
styles.look: Thin irregular ink and flat side-view setting
styles.motion: Thin irregular ink and flat side-view setting; escalate a beat then resolve a gesture.
styles.never: No heavy outline, shading or copied characters.

styles.name: Deep Time
styles.motion: Letterboxed smoky space; one physical event, time jump and stopped camera.
styles.never: No borrowed footage/music, big title or second color family.

styles.name: Neon Silhouette
styles.look: Dark flat figure, coral rim and layered sunset room
styles.motion: Dark flat figure, coral rim and layered sunset room; prop trigger and reaction.
styles.never: No detailed face, neon tubes or copied characters.

styles.name: POV Doodle
styles.look: Rough brown marker and muted painted fills
styles.motion: Rough brown marker and muted painted fills; accelerating repeated events and calendar.
styles.never: No thin vectors, bright colors or moving final hold.

styles.name: Blue Grid
styles.motion: White clay cutaway; orbit, draw force or heat through it, label three parts.
styles.never: No exploded parts, realistic metal or particle storm.

styles.name: Product turntable
styles.motion: Graphite studio and closed product; slow turn, low hero camera, four pinned specs.
styles.never: No teardown, fast spin, colored ground or glow.

styles.name: Money stack
styles.motion: Invented banded note bricks; drop layers, crane up, count once per landing.
styles.never: No banknote artwork, loose bills or counter ahead of stack.

styles.name: Card flip
styles.motion: Thick satin card; true perspective flip, highlight sweep, then three benefits.
styles.never: No flat squash pretending 3D, bank marks or tiny copy.

styles.name: Receipt
styles.look: Curled thermal paper feeds from a dark printer
styles.motion: Curled thermal paper feeds from a dark printer; reveal total last.
styles.never: No typed floating text, fake shop proof or excess items.

styles.name: Iceberg
styles.look: Faceted pale ice in clear water
styles.motion: Faceted pale ice in clear water; dive, pull back, draw slice boundaries and labels.
styles.never: No photoreal texture, bubbles or detached labels.

styles.name: Text thread
styles.look: Short hovering chat on pale grid floor
styles.motion: Short hovering chat on pale grid floor; crane back, pop bubbles, morph key reply.
styles.never: No real app chrome, long text or invented testimonial proof.

styles.name: Scale lineup
styles.look: White clay objects on one baseline
styles.motion: White clay objects on one baseline; one pullback reveals smallest to largest.
styles.never: No chasing camera, uneven labels or unverified dimensions.

styles.name: Milestone trophy
styles.look: Silver plaque and black panel in green studio
styles.motion: Silver plaque and black panel in green studio; lift, turn, odometer milestone.
styles.never: No copied platform awards, confetti or invented achievement.

styles.name: Donut breakdown
styles.look: Muted ring slices sweep in sequentially, total follows, one slice lifts outward.
styles.motion: Muted ring slices sweep in sequentially, total follows, one slice lifts outward.
styles.never: No mismatched totals, rainbow or overlapping legend.

styles.name: Globe arcs
styles.motion: Dark dot-land globe; gentle turn, stagger warm routes, step count at landings.
styles.never: No flat-map substitute, hidden endpoints or fabricated reach.

styles.name: Laptop reveal
styles.motion: Silver laptop with contact shadow; open lid while orbiting front, sharpen UI, scroll/click.
styles.never: No plain-box device, tiny copy or floating clutter.

styles.name: Isometric flow
styles.motion: Orthographic miniature slab; raise three steps, draw road, move an item to completion.
styles.never: No perspective substitute, overlapping labels or opacity entrances.

styles.name: Notification stack
styles.motion: Dark lockscreen and frosted cards; accelerate arrivals, tuck old cards, synchronize totals.
styles.never: No fake sales proof, private client details or shifting digit widths.

styles.name: Before and after slider
styles.motion: Aligned versions under one divider; sweep, then return to an even split.
styles.never: No crossfade, viewpoint mismatch or misleading renovation claim.

styles.name: Ranking bars
styles.look: Six bars, one hero and year
styles.motion: Six bars, one hero and year; interpolate values and ranking, swap exactly at crossings.
styles.never: No teleporting bars, crowded labels or fabricated metrics.

styles.name: Social post receipt
styles.motion: Light post cards, restrained metrics; settle main card, stack replies, rough underline.
styles.never: No false quotations, invented engagement or fake evidence.

styles.name: Day counter
styles.look: Large day count and month-correct calendar
styles.motion: Large day count and month-correct calendar; slow-fast-slow numbers with synced checks.
styles.never: No unsupported streak, wrong weekdays or disconnected checks.

styles.name: Versus
styles.motion: Two dark halves, consistent colors; names land, badge pops, four outward bar rows.
styles.never: No invented winner, third color or bars that contradict numbers.

styles.name: 3D Map Route
styles.motion: Pale low-rise city; rise from location dot, trace streets, drop pin and trip card.
styles.never: Source demo is fictional; never present invented streets or times as a listing location.

styles.name: Exploded Teardown
styles.motion: Believable product layers; lift top-down on distinct beats with drawn leaders.
styles.never: No flat cutout substitute, simultaneous explosion or crossing leaders.

styles.name: Ink Wash
styles.motion: Spare paper landscape; spread wet-edged washes, grow strokes, stamp a red seal.
styles.never: No digital gradient reveal, shadows or broad second color.

styles.name: Paper Desk
styles.motion: Top-down evidence sheets and tape; weighty paper landings, hand-drawn annotations.
styles.never: No fabricated evidence, shadowless sheets or opacity reveal.

styles.name: Headline Highlight
styles.motion: Tilted article over blurred cards; dolly into paragraph, multiply rough highlights, pop source.
styles.never: No false masthead, invented article proof or clean rectangle marker.

styles.name: Stat Chart
styles.motion: Huge tabular value and line; counter tracks line tip, accent changes at a sourced event.
styles.never: No misleading axis, independent counter or unsupported growth.

styles.name: App Mockup
styles.motion: Dimensional phone and crisp UI; settle phone, build screen, morph three cards from chips.
styles.never: No unshipped feature claim, flat fake device or simultaneous arrivals.

styles.name: Screen-Recording Zoom
styles.motion: Crisp UI on quiet field; curved cursor leads one smooth close move, press, step pill.
styles.never: No private files, fuzzy enlarged type or bouncing camera.

styles.name: Timeline
styles.motion: Perspective years and raised cards; playhead leads, cards hinge at their dates.
styles.never: No invented history, early final card or drifting end camera.

styles.name: Glow Orb
styles.look: One luminous orb and sparse circles
styles.motion: One luminous orb and sparse circles; deep breath, gentle parallax, detached ring.
styles.never: No particles, second accent or full-frame glow; Arabic remains joined.

styles.name: Frosted Glass UI
styles.look: Smoked glass on dithered defocused field
styles.motion: Smoked glass on dithered defocused field; query, shift bar, unfold results, stretch highlight.
styles.never: No unreadable white glass, banded blur or fade entrances.

styles.name: Apple One-Take
styles.motion: One carrier on flat ground; morph dot to control to card to device to closing type.
styles.never: No cuts, dissolves or reshaping the official DOMUS logo.

styles.name: Retro CRT Glow
styles.motion: Tube black and white phosphor; unfold scan line, type system text, hold, collapse loop.
styles.never: No neon outline, heavy settled glitch or border.

styles.name: Oscilloscope
styles.motion: One monoline trace; wave to Lissajous to damped line to connected word.
styles.never: No swapped letters, neon-sign halo or corner readouts.

styles.name: Magazine Layout and Note
styles.look: Serif editorial hierarchy and photo column
styles.motion: Serif editorial hierarchy and photo column; masked lines, photo reveal, stroke note.
styles.never: No fake handwriting typewriter, photo frame or page curl.

styles.name: Blue Editorial
styles.motion: Flat blue cover stack; scale jumps, slanted wipes, tucked words and sliced type.
styles.never: No third face, glow or Swiss grid; move Arabic words or lines.

styles.name: Risograph
styles.look: Two mottled ink plates and halftones
styles.motion: Two mottled ink plates and halftones; animate on twos, stamp, slip and realign.
styles.never: No smooth motion blur, clean vectors or extra ink.

styles.name: Swiss Grid
styles.motion: Modular grid and aligned type; draw grid, step circle, expand cells, lock baselines.
styles.never: No gradients, arbitrary landing or glow; mirror Arabic alignment.

styles.name: Pencil to Blueprint
styles.look: Same schematic from graphite to technical ink
styles.motion: Same schematic from graphite to technical ink; construct, draw, irregular flood, dimension.
styles.never: No swapped object, invented real property plan or unsupported measurements.
